points.point: Can a post be scheduled about 11 months ahead?
points.sentence: The furthest date in the future you can schedule a post for is 9 months on every plan.

points.point: 11 months is past the limit, so what happens
points.sentence: If you try to schedule a post past 9 months, Blotato returns an error.

verdict.reason: The scheduling-horizon entry states the 9-month limit on every plan, so an 11-month-ahead post can't be scheduled yet and would return an error.
